Method of Attack: Supply-chain ransomware attack exploiting zero-day vulnerability CVE-2021-30116 in Kaseya VSA on-premises servers
Ransomware encryption of managed service providers' and their customers' systems
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability CVE-2021-30116 in Kaseya VSA
Supply-chain attack via patch management and client monitoring software
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Kaseya VSA Detection Tool to identify indicators of compromise
